register.labelZh: SING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sing along 可以用來描述跟朋友、表演者、錄音、影片或歌曲一起唱。；你可以在派對、車上、學校表演期間或收聽電台時 sing along。；sing out 和 sing something out 表示某人放聲並清楚地唱,讓聽眾聽得到。；當歌者的聲音太小時,sing up 是要求對方唱大聲一點的自然說法。
register.summaryEn: Sing along lets you describe singing with friends, performers, recordings, films or songs. You can sing along at a party, in a car, during a school show or while listening to the radio. Sing out and sing something out show that a person is singing loudly and clearly enough for an audience to hear. Sing up is a direct and natural way to tell a quiet singer that their voice needs to be louder.
